scope: Bounded final read-only review of SOURCE-CONVERSION-R1 plus timestamp amendment R2. Reviewed input mirror/state lifetimes, error precedence, shared retained prepare helper, exact source scope, and the 13-path allowlist. No source, test, Git, Vault, network, or external-process mutation.
freeze_status: The contract remains effective only when the future SOURCE-CONVERSION-freeze-r1.json binds these exact bytes, the allowlist, and the delivered source-publication base.

base_reference.source_publication_reference: Provided by root as the about-to-be-delivered R2 base; this review does not relabel or independently accept that candidate.

checks.evidence: R1 fixes the existing formal-source convert leaf and keeps registration, operator apply, promotion, and display selection outside the command. The 13-path allowlist contains the formal_source registration, conversion modules, shared source-publication module, schema, docs, and contract/security/upstream tests only.

The concrete session retains the named .light-knowledge root and ancestors, captures every entry including unrelated records/jobs/staging/views/ownership and empty directories, and rejects links, special files, path aliases, non-NFC names, casefold collisions, and complete-set changes.

The selected source.md/source.json, capture authority, and optional metadata are retained before typed parsing and through every exit. The descriptor-relative retained-file pattern retains all named ancestors and rereads bytes and identity; implementation must apply the same named-edge lifetime to the workspace/papers/<digest> path used for acquisition.

R1 requires a fresh nonce mirror under .work/<batch>/source-conversion/inputs-<32-lowercase-hex>, no live-root fallback, immediate mirror complete-set capture, retention through validation/assembly/staging, and original-plus-mirror verification on success, ordinary failure, and acquisition failure.

WORK_PATH_UNSAFE explicitly supersedes an ordinary validation or staleness error when final retained-input safety verification fails; semantic ContractError codes, pointers, and exit codes survive when safety is unchanged.

The allowed branch is limited to current_head_record_id, _owned_record_bundle, _record_bundle_ok, _record_source_status, _load_paper, and _derived_chunks on the mirror. No resume, import, finalize, current-plan-binding, workspace identity regeneration, index rebuild, or search route is permitted.
The selected record/source validation path is independent of .light-index. Existing plan.workspace_id remains persisted original data and is never rewritten for the generated mirror.

R1 requires recomputation of formal_source._observe with the authority canonical ID/version and exact observation/raw-byte equality. The declared original_pdf_sha256 remains metadata provenance; no original PDF read or copy is introduced and no new _observe restriction is added.

The private helper receives already validated batch/operation/current/audit/retained snapshot state. The public prepare wrapper opens its own audited snapshot; conversion passes its existing session state, preventing a second live Vault read while preserving request, transaction, payload, no-op, and error behavior.

R2 requires proposed_at to be explicit, calendar-valid, whole-second UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. This matches the existing source-ledger and claim-ledger generated_at 20-character requirement. It correctly leaves metadata.published_at as the existing date/UTC union, permits equal timestamps, skips chronology comparisons for unchanged no-ops, and preserves the prior source-ledger snapshot before the first modification.

R1 separates SOURCE_CONVERSION_INVALID, SOURCE_CONVERSION_STALE, and SOURCE_CONVERSION_UNSUPPORTED_CHANGE from lower-level schema/identity/registration/publication errors; stale/unsupported remain exit 75 and safety remains WORK_PATH_UNSAFE.

implementation_watchpoints: The source_conversion_io implementation must retain and verify the workspace/papers/<digest> ancestor chain as well as the two selected source files, so direct acquisition cannot escape through a replaced parent directory.
The helper extraction must be byte-compatible with the accepted source-publication base before conversion-specific assembly is added.
The future freeze JSON must bind this R1, the R2 amendment, the 13-path allowlist, and the exact delivered source-publication base.
